title: orch pull-requests ticket data: ext.pull-requests
description: Owned by the pull-requests add-on (its ticket_ext and ticket_fields; the add-on ships a byte-identical copy). merge_when_green = on: the add-on's background service puts the ticket's open, ready pull requests in the merge queue, which merges each only on green checks of the checked commit. Not inert: it starts merges.

merge_when_green.title: Merge when green
merge_when_green.description: on = merge this ticket's pull requests by themselves once every check passed. Absent or off = no.
